title: Charting the silent variation within us
title_zh: 绘制我们内在的静默变异
abstract: Every cell in the human body carries its own genome, shaped by mutations acquired over a lifetime, yet this vast somatic variation has been nearly impossible to measure. The SMaHT Network now delivers benchmarked tools and the first body-wide map of somatic mosaicism, establishing a baseline of "normal" against which its roles in development, aging, and disease can finally be tested.
abstract_zh: 人体内的每个细胞都携带着自身的基因组，受到一生中获得的突变所塑造，但这种庞大的体细胞变异几乎无法测量。SMaHT 网络现在提供了经过基准测试的工具和首个全身体细胞嵌合图谱，确立了“正常”基线，从而可以最终检验其在发育、衰老和疾病中的作用。
